brief: AI affiliate marketing for beginners. The four affiliate programs solo founders are quietly making $5k/month from, and how they're driving traffic.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.headline: 4 AI Affiliate Programs Quietly Making Founders $5K/Month
slots.body: Solo founders are using AI tools to drive traffic and earn passive income. Here are the four programs they don't talk about.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: The Quiet $5K Blueprint
slots.body: Solo founders stopped trading time for money. They now leverage AI tools with generous recurring commissions and automated content funnels to build passive revenue streams.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: AI Copywriting Suites
slots.body: Tools like Jasper and Copy.ai offer 30% lifetime recurring commissions. Founders review templates on Twitter and LinkedIn, capturing search intent with AI-optimized comparison threads.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: AI Video Repurposing
slots.body: Opus Clip and Pictory pay up to 50% recurring. Affiliates drive traffic by posting before-and-after clips on TikTok and YouTube Shorts, linking directly in bio.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: Creator Newsletter Platforms
slots.body: Beehiiv and ConvertKit reward affiliates with hundreds per signup. Founders build micro-newsletters around AI tips, then monetize through embedded affiliate links and partner networks.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: AI Design & Images
slots.body: Leonardo.ai and Canva offer high-volume bounties. Affiliates create viral prompt galleries on Pinterest and Instagram, turning aesthetic inspiration into a steady downstream commission funnel.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.title: The Traffic Engine
slots.body: The secret isn't ads. Founders use AI SEO tools to publish fifty optimized articles monthly, then funnel readers into an email sequence that converts on autopilot.

slots.author: Jordan Lee
slots.headline: Which Program Will You Launch First?
slots.body: Pick one program, build a simple content system, and start earning. The best time to start was yesterday.
